data.name: Eyman
data.gender_notes: Eyman is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: one who has a beautiful face or is gracious and charming. The name Eyman carries the meaning “beauty, grace, charm” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Eyman usually hope their child will grow to embody beauty, grace, charm and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: representing the inner beauty and grace of a person
data.etymology: Eyman belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “beauty, grace, charm.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Eyman total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: إيمان
in_arabic.meaning: إيمان هو اسم يعني الإيمان بالله واليقين
in_arabic.long_meaning: إيمان هو اسم مشتق من الإيمان بالله، ويعني اليقين والاعتقاد الراسخ بالله تعالى. ورد ذكر الإيمان في القرآن الكريم في عدة مواضع، ويعتبر الإيمان بالله من أساسيات الدين الإسلامي. يستخدم هذا الاسم للدلالة على الشخص الذي يتصف بالإيمان القوي والقلب السليم.

in_urdu.name: ایمان
in_urdu.meaning: ایمان مطلب ہے اللہ پر یقین اور ایمان
in_urdu.long_meaning: ایمان ایک ایسا نام ہے جو اللہ پر یقین اور ایمان سے ماخوذ ہے۔ یہ نام عربی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے جہاں اس کا مطلب ہے 'اللہ پر یقین'۔ قرآن کریم میں ایمان کی महत्ता کو بار بار ذکر کیا گیا ہے، اور یہ اسلامی عقیدے کی بنیاد ہے۔ یہ نام ایک ایسے شخص کے لئے استعمال ہوتا ہے جو اپنے دل کی گہرائیوں سے اللہ پر یقین رکھتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: ईमान
in_hindi.meaning: ईमान का अर्थ है भगवान पर विश्वास और आस्था
in_hindi.long_meaning: ईमान एक ऐसा नाम है जो भगवान पर विश्वास और आस्था से लिया गया है। यह नाम अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है जहां इसका अर्थ है 'भगवान पर विश्वास'। कुरआन में आस्था के महत्व को बार-बार उल्लेख किया गया है, और यह इस्लामी विश्वास की नींव है। यह नाम उस व्यक्ति के लिए प्रयोग किया जाता है जो अपने दिल की गहराइयों से भगवान पर विश्वास करता है।

in_pashto.name: ایمان
in_pashto.meaning: ایمان د لوي خدای باندې د باور معنی لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: ایمان داسې نوم دی چی د لوي خدای باندې د باور څخه اخیستل شوی دی. دا نوم د عربي ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی دی چي په هغه کې د معنی یې د 'خدای باندې باور' دی. په قرآن کریم کې د ایمان اهمیت په مکرر ډول بیان شوی دی، او دا د اسلامي عقیدې اساس دی. دا نوم د هغه چا لپاره کارول کیږي چي د خپل زړه په ګوټ کې خدای باندې باور ولري.

in_english.name: Eyman
in_english.meaning: Eyman means strong faith and conviction in Allah
in_english.long_meaning: Eyman is an Arabic name derived from the root 'I-M-N', which signifies faith, belief, and conviction. The Quran mentions faith in numerous verses, emphasizing its importance as a cornerstone of Islam. The name Eyman represents an individual with unwavering faith and a strong spiritual foundation. It symbolizes trust, loyalty, and devotion to Allah.

data.cultural_impact: The name Eyman holds a significant cultural impact as it is associated with beauty, grace, and charm. In Middle Eastern and Islamic cultures, physical and moral beauty are highly valued traits. Naming a child Eyman is a way of expressing hope and expectation that they will grow up to embody these desirable qualities, both internally and externally. This name can be a source of pride for parents, as it suggests that their child is not only physically attractive but also possesses a gracious and charming personality.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Eyman can be seen as a reminder of the inner beauty and grace that we all possess as human beings, created in the image of God. It can serve as a reminder to strive towards developing the beautiful qualities of the heart, such as kindness, compassion, and generosity. The name Eyman can also be a source of inspiration to live up to the highest moral and ethical standards, and to radiate inner beauty that shines outwardly, attracting positive energy and good fortunes. Ultimately, the spiritual significance of the name Eyman reminds us that true beauty lies not in the physical appearance alone, but in the beauty of character and the grace of the soul.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "beauty, grace, charm" symbolizes one who has a beautiful face or is gracious and charming. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Eyman serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of beauty, grace, charm.
